items.description: Mini Maxi Movers is a removals company based in Eloffsdal, Pretoria, offering household removals and office relocations for moves within the city and across the province. The company positions itself as a dependable, personal moving service, stating that it handles every move, whether a small local job or a larger relocation, with care, integrity and professionalism. Its stated mission is to make moving easy, efficient and stress-free for both home and office clients, treating customers' belongings as if they were its own. Mini Maxi Movers describes its team as trained and experienced in handling a range of household and office items, and promotes its pricing as affordable without compromising on quality. On its website, the company reports measuring its performance through two self-tracked metrics: a 97% successful-move rate and a 95% customer-satisfaction rate. The business frames its work as moving more than belongings, aiming to support clients' broader relocation needs with reliability and a personal approach throughout the moving process from quote to delivery.

MIX N MATCH is a home textiles business in Elardus Park, Pretoria, offering curtains, blinds, upholstery and fabric services. Its curtain and blind range includes roller, Roman, Venetian and blockout styles, with professional measurement and installation and custom sizing available for any window shape. The business also provides upholstery services, including full furniture restoration backed by a wide fabric selection and expert pattern matching, supported by a before-and-after consultation process. For fabric buyers, MIX N MATCH stocks a curated range of premium materials, including linen, cotton, outdoor-rated fabrics and blockout lining, with indoor and outdoor varieties and some sustainable, eco-friendly options. Its bedding and linen offering covers sheets, duvet covers and pillowcases, including Egyptian cotton options, with a complete size chart and documented thread counts and care instructions to guide buyers. The company states it has been trusted by more than 500 customers and promotes expert fabric consultation across its curtain, upholstery, fabric and bedding ranges, aiming to provide complete textile solutions for the home.

MJL Communications is a Centurion-based ICT and telecommunications provider whose service range, set out on its website's navigation, spans voice, connectivity, security and print solutions. Its voice offering covers VoIP IP PBX and Cloud PBX systems, along with video conferencing and call-recording functionality for business communications. On the connectivity side, the company provides data fibre and wireless internet solutions for business premises. Its security division offers CCTV systems as well as Ajax security systems for alarm and monitoring needs. MJL Communications also supplies print-related services, including printers, scanners and document workflow solutions, positioning the company as a provider covering multiple areas of business technology infrastructure. The company operates from Centurion Central and structures its offering around these core solution areas, voice, connectivity, security and document and print management, for business customers across the region.

Moonlighter Group is a Pretoria-based ICT consultancy operating from Doornpoort, providing consulting, software development, cloud, cybersecurity and digital-transformation services. The company positions itself around using technology to help organisations grow market share through product and service innovation, assessing for each client whether an incremental improvement, a disruptive innovation or a breakthrough innovation best fits their needs. Its consulting arm works with organisations looking to leverage technology to augment existing business processes, while its development arm follows rapid application development methods, using flexible, agile processes that incorporate knowledge gained as a project progresses. Moonlighter Group states that it delivers projects within a maximum six-to-nine month timeline, dividing larger projects into development cycles so that each phase delivers real business functionality and benefit. The company says its project managers are strong technology specialists tasked with ensuring delivery within agreed time and budget limits, and it emphasises quality assurance as part of its delivery approach from Doornpoort, Pretoria.

Moot Bargains is a marketing and advertising agency based in East Lynne, Pretoria, offering branding, digital campaigns, strategic design and campaign management services for business clients. The agency describes its approach as data-driven, combining strategy with creative execution to produce measurable results across social media, search and content marketing channels. It positions itself as a practical, outcome-oriented partner, emphasising clear collaboration and communication with clients throughout a project. Services on offer include tailored branding work, digital campaign development and ongoing campaign management, with the agency aiming to grow a client's business through coordinated creative and strategic input rather than a single, isolated marketing tactic. The East Lynne premises offer wheelchair-accessible parking for visiting clients. Moot Bargains frames its offering around combining creative design with data-backed decision-making, serving businesses that need support across multiple marketing disciplines at once.

Mshandukani Holdings is a civil construction and geotechnical consultancy registered with South Africa's Department of Trade and Industry under the Private Company Act of 1984. The company states its founding aim is to help achieve a non-racial, integrated society through sustainable development, wealth creation, poverty alleviation and equity. Its main services span civil construction and surveying, geotechnical investigation, exploration services including diamond core and percussion drilling, ground water services, geophysics, environmental management, and the acquisition of prospecting and mining rights and licences. The company's portfolio includes work on the Radisson Hotel in Mpumalanga, the Acacia Villas development in Midrand, and the Autumn Leaf Mall and associated Autumn Leaf Road project in Zeerust, North West. Mshandukani Holdings is based in Celtisdal, Centurion, and structures its work around civil and building construction, hydrogeological services, geotechnical investigation services, and exploration and mine-support services for clients across multiple provinces.

Mushore Civils & Projects is a construction company based in Rietfontein, Pretoria, operating as a single provider for residential and commercial construction needs. Its work covers new building, renovations and maintenance for homes, shops, offices, schools and factories, with the stated aim of giving customers one point of contact rather than requiring them to source multiple separate service providers. The company's growth strategy is built around customer satisfaction, working from the view that one satisfied client can lead to further referrals. Mushore Civils & Projects operates according to a stated code of ethics committing the business to being fair, honest, impartial, respectful and professional, and to act in good faith in all business relationships, prioritising client interests except where doing so would breach a law or its own code. It commits to being truthful about its licences and certifications, providing supporting documentation on request, and acting as a responsible steward of the environment in its contracting practices.

MyCustomShop is a father-and-son business based in Kloofsig, Centurion, specialising in custom vehicle modifications and accessories for off-road vehicles and bakkies. The company designs and supplies products tailored to specific vehicles and customer needs, covering accessories described as suited to everything from driving to braaiing. Rather than operating a single fitment centre of its own, MyCustomShop offers several fitment and shipping options: customers can have products fitted in-house, fitted through TyreMart Centurion, or arrange fitment and accessories through Alpha Accessories, which also ships ordered products directly to customers' doors. The business presents itself as combining a personal, hands-on approach with attention to design detail, aiming to bring customers' ideas for off-roading and bakkie accessories to life. MyCustomShop positions its product range and partner-fitment network as a way to serve customers locally and further afield, supplying both the products themselves and the means to have them properly installed.

NGV Geotechnical & Exploration operates from Tierpoort in Pretoria East, providing integrated geotechnical, geological, geophysical and mineral exploration services to developers, mining companies, prospecting-right holders, landowners, investors, mining-permit holders, engineering firms and infrastructure projects. Its geotechnical investigation service responds to the common requirement from contractors, municipalities, banks and other parties for a geotechnical report before a new construction or extension project proceeds. The company also offers mineral exploration and advisory services, helping clients identify high-value exploration targets, reduce risk, and make decisions from early-stage exploration through to drilling. A further service, geological desktop and reconnaissance work, involves assessing geochemistry, remote sensing data, regional geology and geophysics, borehole records, mineral potential, historical exploration activity and other field indicators to identify priority targets. NGV Geotechnical & Exploration also conducts dolomite stability investigations, assessing the stability of dolomite rock formations in a given area, and describes itself as a single geotechnical firm serving clients across South Africa.

Nienaber Attorneys is a boutique law firm based in Midstream, Centurion, serving clients across South Africa from its Pretoria-area base. The firm specialises in property law, estates and fiduciary law, and contractual litigation and dispute resolution, with a particular focus on real estate and franchising matters. Its real estate practice covers conveyancing assistance for property transfers, specialist advice for closing commercial real estate transactions, and dispute resolution services for rental and sale disputes. On the fiduciary side, the firm provides notary services and practical advice on wills, estate planning and the administration of deceased estates, as well as company and trust formation and administration. Nienaber Attorneys states that its goal is to be recognised as a leading real estate and fiduciary law firm in its community, built on a commitment to service excellence and practical, customised legal advice, structuring its offering around real estate, fiduciary matters and dispute resolution.

Nomaciko Projects is a construction company based in Theresapark, Pretoria, delivering new builds, renovations and extensions for residential and other clients. The company positions its work around high-quality workmanship combined with professional, detail-oriented project delivery, aiming to give clients a seamless, calm building experience from concept through to completion. Nomaciko Projects emphasises clear communication throughout a project and offers customised solutions designed to align with each client's specific budget and deadlines rather than a single fixed package. The company's premises in Theresapark include wheelchair-accessible parking for visiting clients. By combining new-build, renovation and extension work under one team, Nomaciko Projects presents itself as a construction provider able to manage a range of residential building projects while keeping a strong focus on workmanship quality and client-specific planning throughout each job.

Nubia Restobar is a restaurant and bar in Blue Valley Mall, at the corner of Bothrill Avenue in Centurion. The venue operates as a sit-down restaurant with an attached bar, trading into the late hours, with listed opening hours running from 11:00 to 02:00. Nubia Restobar's menu draws particular attention for its seafood, including prawns, alongside tapas-style sharing dishes and meat and poultry options such as chicken. The restaurant is noted for its decor and atmosphere, described as pairing a considered interior design with a lively setting for diners. Pricing at Nubia Restobar sits in the upper bracket for Centurion dining, with typical spend per person quoted at over R1,000. The combination of a tapas-style sharing menu alongside full seafood and meat dishes positions Nubia Restobar as a restaurant aimed at diners looking for a fuller dining and bar experience within the Blue Valley Golf Estate area of Centurion.

Obsideo Consulting is part of the Obsideo Group, based in Irene Farm Villages, Centurion, which also includes Obsideo Holdings as parent company, along with Obsideo Project & Technical Services, Obsideo Construction, Obsideo Plant Hire and Obsideo Estates. The group provides engineering and management solutions for the mining, mineral processing and chemical industries. Obsideo states that it operates on a foundation of transparency and ethical conduct in project delivery, aiming to build professional relationships based on trust and open communication with clients. Its approach to contracting includes EPC, partnership and turnkey models, though it favours a transparent, open-book EPCM basis in which capital costs, contingencies, fees, invoicing arrangements and any shared discounts are agreed upfront. The company highlights particular expertise in the design, construction, commissioning and operation of pilot plants, which allow metallurgical processes for specific mineral sources to be tested and confirmed at a small scale before a client commits full capital to a project.

Oh So Tech is an IT support provider based in Doornpoort, Pretoria, offering managed IT services, tech support, connectivity solutions, cybersecurity, CCTV and on-site repairs for homes, small businesses and SMEs, and states that it is trusted by more than 50 SMEs across Gauteng. Its data services cover data recovery from accidental deletion or corrupted storage, data migration and transfer, cloud and local backup solutions, and data encryption and security. On the networking side, the company handles network setup and configuration for LAN and Wi-Fi environments, router and modem installation, network troubleshooting and repair, cabling and infrastructure setup, wireless network optimisation and VPN setup and management. Its software services include operating system installation and updates, software installation and configuration, application troubleshooting, driver updates, system optimisation and antivirus and malware removal. Oh So Tech also provides server services, including physical server installation and rack mounting, server hardware configuration, and setup of Active Directory, file sharing and domain services with backup integration for disaster recovery.

Oikonomos, trading as OKSA, is a chartered accounting firm based in Koedoespoort Industrial, Pretoria, founded in 2021 to provide technical and strategic professional services to individuals, entrepreneurs and corporate clients. The firm states that its team brings over 30 years of cumulative experience across Big Four firms, corporate environments and family businesses. Its name is drawn from Oikonomos, meaning a trusted steward of household or public finances, reflecting a stated focus on building long-term, trust-based relationships with clients around their financial affairs. OKSA's service lines include accounting and payroll, tax and secretarial compliance, taxation, business intelligence and financial statement preparation. On the tax side, services include preparing and submitting provisional and annual income tax returns, informing clients of amounts owed to SARS and when payments are due, VAT registration, and supporting tax computations based on client-supplied information. Its secretarial services cover storage of company records, registration of new companies, preparation of a memorandum of incorporation, and maintenance of the share register and AGM minutes.

Phosa Loots Attorneys Inc is a law firm with its Pretoria branch based at Boardwalk Office Park in Faerie Glen, and a second branch in Gqeberha. The firm's areas of practice span civil litigation, conveyancing and property law, commercial law, corporate law, criminal law, customary law, family law, labour law, and land reform and land claims. This spread of practice areas allows the firm to act for both individual and business clients across a range of legal needs, from property transactions and corporate matters through to family, labour and customary law disputes. Operating from two offices in different provinces, Phosa Loots Attorneys Inc positions itself as a firm able to serve clients with a broad base of legal expertise rather than a narrow specialisation. Its Pretoria branch, located within the Boardwalk Office Park complex in Faerie Glen, forms its base for serving clients in the greater Pretoria and Centurion area.

This Pick n Pay store is located at Hazeldean Square, on the corner of Graham and Silver Lakes Road in Pretoria East. The store offers fresh produce, organic selections and ready-to-eat food options alongside bakery items, combining in-store shopping with the option of in-store pickup or delivery for orders placed off-site. Customers can pay by credit or debit card, and the store provides a wheelchair-accessible entrance and wheelchair-accessible parking for shoppers with mobility needs. As part of the Hazeldean Square retail node, the store positions itself as a convenient, full-range grocery option combining everyday essentials with prepared and organic food choices. The combination of in-store shopping, bakery goods and both pickup and delivery service options is aimed at giving shoppers flexibility in how they buy their groceries at this particular Pretoria East location.

Pie City Rossly Factory is a pie-focused bakery located in Rosslyn Plaza, at the corner of De Waal Street and Daan Geyser Street in Rosslyn, Pretoria. The outlet offers savoury pies, sweet treats and breakfast options, available either for in-store shopping or as takeout, with credit card payments accepted. The premises provide a wheelchair-accessible entrance and wheelchair-accessible parking for customers. Pie City Rossly Factory trades Monday to Saturday, giving it regular daytime trading hours through the working week. As part of the wider Pie City network, this Rosslyn outlet focuses specifically on pie baking alongside a smaller range of sweet treats and breakfast items, positioning it as a quick-service bakery stop for both sit-down and takeaway customers within the Rosslyn Plaza retail centre in the Akasia area of Pretoria.

PIPECO South Africa, trading under the names PCT Tanks and PCW Tanks, was formed in 1984 as an engineering hardware company before moving into sectional panel water tanks in 1989. Based in Sunderland Ridge, Centurion, the company manufactures and supplies both pressed-steel and GRP (glass-reinforced plastic) sectional water tanks, and describes itself as having 28 years of experience supplying and installing these tanks for the South African market. PIPECO is accredited to the ISO 9001:2000 standard, which it says ensures that tank panels and accessories are produced under a stringent quality-audit process so that each tank meets required structural and durability performance standards. The company operates as part of a global network, with partnerships in Malaysia, Singapore and other parts of South East Asia, Middle Eastern countries including the United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and Oman, and in Europe in France and Belgium, as well as in Australia.

Plastilon Packaging's Gezina branch, located in Rietfontein, Pretoria, operates as a packaging supplier stocking more than 6,000 products across a wide range of categories. Its range includes bags, bottles, boxes, buckets, crates, drums and glassware, alongside paper products, protective packaging, food packaging, tapes and tubing, and gift packaging such as gift bags, gift boxes, tissue paper and void fillers. The store also carries a cleaning and chemicals range covering automotive, household, laundry, personal care, industrial and pet-related products, along with brushware and mops. Plastilon offers free delivery on orders over R750 and accepts EFT payments, with the company stating that customer support is available within 24 hours. The combination of a large product catalogue with bulk-buying options positions this Rietfontein branch as a packaging supplier for both individual and business customers needing anything from everyday food packaging to cleaning supplies and gift-wrapping materials.

Precious Gold Properties is an estate agency serving Centurion and the surrounding areas, with its listed coverage extending to Midstream, Pretoria East, Mamelodi, The Reeds and Randburg. The agency offers both residential sales and rentals, along with a free home valuation service for homeowners considering selling, and support for sellers and buyers transacting at the same time. It also lists assistance for clients struggling with bond payments as part of its property services. On the new-development side, Precious Gold Properties markets property in Midstream, Lombardy Estate and Louwlardia Estates. The agency promotes its reputation within the real estate industry, emphasising open and responsive communication with clients throughout a transaction and describing its buying strategy as combining market knowledge, negotiation skills and professional experience to help clients secure property at the right price across the Centurion, Pretoria and Johannesburg markets.

Precision Medical Solutions is a medical practice administration company established in 2008, with offices in Gauteng and the Western Cape supporting clients countrywide. The company offers tailored practice-management services for medical specialists, aiming to take the administrative burden out of running a private practice. Its offering includes comprehensive management support covering all medical specialties, delivered through its MedEBill platform combined with personal service from its staff. Precision Medical Solutions also assists practitioners who are starting a new private practice, aiming to make the transition from employment or training into private practice easier and less stressful. The company promotes competitive, affordable pricing structured to fit a range of practice budgets, alongside ongoing investment in current technology to support its service delivery, and describes its staff as led by a management team bringing both financial and medical expertise to the running of client practices.

Pretoria East Electrical Services is a locally owned and registered electrical company based in Olympus, Pretoria East, offering 24-hour electrical repairs, installations and compliance certificates for homes and businesses. The company's team of qualified electricians handles a range of callouts, including tripping circuit breakers, power outages and faults, and unsafe wiring, alongside more specific jobs such as DB board repairs, geyser electrical repairs, electrical fault finding and lighting installation. Pretoria East Electrical Services states that it serves Pretoria East and its surrounding suburbs, with its website specifically listing electrician services for Garsfontein and Faerie Glen alongside its core Pretoria East coverage. The business markets itself around being reliable, affordable and locally trusted, aiming to provide safe, professional electrical work completed correctly the first time, combining emergency, 24-hour response with planned work such as installations, fault-finding and lighting jobs.

Pro Beat Auto Body is a panel-beating and collision-repair workshop in the N4 Gateway Industrial Park, Willow Park Manor, established in 2001. The company says it has achieved the highest possible grading as a major structural repairer, reflecting its use of current technology and repair and refinishing standards within the automotive repair industry. Its services include frame and chassis straightening, painting with guaranteed colour matching, paintless dent repair, aluminium repair, and collision and towing assistance, supported by a 24-hour drive-in and assessment centre. Pro Beat Auto Body works with all major insurance companies to schedule, inspect and repair vehicles following a collision, handling jobs ranging from minor damage to larger structural repairs. The workshop states it is regularly audited by regulatory bodies, and is approved to carry out repairs to strict manufacturer standards set by brands including Volkswagen, Audi, Toyota, Nissan, Hyundai, Citroen, Peugeot, Kia, Ford, Mazda, Suzuki, Honda, Mitsubishi, Land Rover, Jaguar and Renault.
